technique_name: Construct a dialogue in which an AI assistant has to explain the difference between random forest and support vector machines algorithms.
description:
AI Assistant: Hi, I can help explain the difference between Random Forest and Support Vector Machines.

User: Please do!

AI Assistant: Sure. Random Forest is an ensemble machine learning technique, where the model creates a set of decision trees and the result or prediction is the average of the predictions from all the decision trees.
